thinking_text:
**Evaluating global features**

I'm considering that the global top and bottom faces aren't adjacent. They connect through all the side surfaces, which suggests they might have separate features. It seems logical to think of them as distinct aspects, possibly with a top skin and a bottom skin for each. This separation could lead to interesting characteristics or functionalities in whatever context I'm applying these features.

part_functions.name: fastener_turning
part_functions.function: Transfers hand-applied torque through either an open jaw or a closed ring interface to rotate fasteners.

part_functions.name: dual_access
part_functions.function: Provides an open end for lateral engagement and a ring end for enclosed engagement, allowing use under different access conditions.

part_functions.name: load_transfer
part_functions.function: The monolithic handle structurally joins the two working heads and carries bending and torsional loads between the user's grip and the engaged fastener.

sections.name: open-jaw head at the longitudinal front (-Z end)

section_functions.name: open_fastener_interface
section_functions.function: The two jaws and U-shaped throat laterally receive a fastener and react torque through the opposed inner jaw walls.

section_functions.name: jaw_load_distribution
section_functions.function: Large curved outer lobes provide material around the jaw walls, while rounded throat transitions reduce stress concentration where the opening merges into the handle.

section_functions.name: handle_relationship
section_functions.function: The left and right outer neck transitions are adjacent to the corresponding handle side rails and transfer jaw reaction loads into the central handle.

features.name: open-jaw perimeter, throat, and neck transitions

feature_functions.name: fastener_capture
feature_functions.function: Opposed straight jaw faces constrain two sides of a fastener while the recessed throat supplies clearance behind it.

feature_functions.name: structural_behavior
feature_functions.function: The approximately symmetric outer lobes resist jaw spreading; cylindrical root blends redirect load smoothly into the throat floor and handle.

feature_functions.name: geometric_relationship
feature_functions.function: The jaw walls are opposed and nominally symmetric about the longitudinal center plane; the throat floor lies between two symmetric root fillets.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Left outer neck blend joining the handle side to the left jaw lobe.
Large curved exterior surface of the left open-end jaw lobe.
Straight left inner jaw wall extending inward from the open mouth.
Rounded left throat-root transition between the left jaw wall and throat floor.
Central closed floor of the U-shaped open-jaw throat.
Rounded right throat-root transition between the throat floor and right jaw wall.
Straight right inner jaw wall extending outward to the open mouth.
Large curved exterior surface of the right open-end jaw lobe.
Right outer neck blend joining the right jaw lobe to the handle side.

sections.name: central elongated handle between the two heads

section_functions.name: manual_lever
section_functions.function: Provides the grip length and lever arm needed to generate torque at either working head.

section_functions.name: structural_spine
section_functions.function: The full-thickness side rails and broad bottom skin form a stiff spine that carries bending and torsional loads between the heads.

section_functions.name: recess_behavior
section_functions.function: A shallow top recess reduces local material and visually defines the grip while retaining raised perimeter rails for stiffness and handling.

section_functions.name: section_relationship
section_functions.function: The handle is structurally continuous with both heads; its opposed side rails connect to the corresponding left and right neck blends at each end.

feature_functions.name: bending_resistance
feature_functions.function: The long side walls preserve section depth and act as load-carrying rails along the handle.

feature_functions.name: symmetry_relationship
feature_functions.function: The left and right rails are opposed across the handle centerline and connect the corresponding sides of the open and ring heads.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Long left exterior side wall of the handle between the two head transitions.
Long right exterior side wall of the handle between the two head transitions.

features.name: shallow rounded-rectangular grip recess on the top face

feature_functions.name: material_relief
feature_functions.function: Removes a shallow layer from the central handle without penetrating the part, reducing mass while retaining a raised border.

feature_functions.name: grip_indexing
feature_functions.function: The recessed panel gives a tactile and visual gripping region bounded by rounded corners.

feature_functions.name: structural_relationship
feature_functions.function: The recessed floor is surrounded by four boundary walls and four cylindrical corner blends, all adjacent to the raised top skin.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Short end wall at the ring-end boundary of the shallow handle recess.
Rounded right corner wall at the ring-end of the recess.
Long right side wall of the shallow recessed panel.
Rounded right corner wall at the open-jaw end of the recess.
Short end wall at the open-jaw boundary of the shallow handle recess.
Rounded left corner wall at the open-jaw end of the recess.
Long left side wall of the shallow recessed panel.
Rounded left corner wall at the ring-end of the recess.
Flat recessed floor located 1 mm below the surrounding top face.

features.name: raised top skin surrounding the recess and openings

feature_functions.name: upper_load_surface
feature_functions.function: Forms the continuous top boundary of the monolithic wrench and retains raised material around the recess, ring hole, and open jaw.

feature_functions.name: cross_section_relationship
feature_functions.function: This single planar face spans all three logical sections and joins their perimeter and opening walls at the top edge.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Continuous top face of the wrench, interrupted by the handle recess, ring opening, and open-jaw slot.

feature_functions.name: lower_load_surface
feature_functions.function: Provides an uninterrupted lower flange across the handle and both heads, contributing to bending stiffness.

feature_functions.name: support_surface
feature_functions.function: Creates a planar bottom surface on which the wrench can rest.

feature_functions.name: cross_section_relationship
feature_functions.function: This single planar face spans all logical sections and is connected to the top skin through the exterior and opening side walls.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Continuous flat bottom face spanning the open head, handle, and ring head.

sections.name: closed ring head at the longitudinal back (+Z end)

section_functions.name: enclosed_fastener_interface
section_functions.function: The circular through-opening surrounds a compatible fastener or cylindrical element and distributes contact around its circumference.

section_functions.name: ring_load_distribution
section_functions.function: The annular head carries circumferential tension and compression around the opening during torque application.

section_functions.name: handle_relationship
section_functions.function: Rounded neck blends join the ring exterior to the opposed handle rails and reduce stress concentration at the head-to-handle transition.

features.name: annular outer head and neck blends

feature_functions.name: ring_reinforcement
feature_functions.function: Provides a thick annular wall around the central opening to resist ovalization and transmit torque.

feature_functions.name: load_transition
feature_functions.function: The left and right rounded blends transfer ring reactions into the straight handle rails.

feature_functions.name: symmetry_relationship
feature_functions.function: The two neck blends flank the longitudinal centerline and are adjacent to opposite sides of the outer ring surface.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Left rounded exterior transition from the handle rail into the ring head.
Main convex cylindrical outer perimeter of the closed ring head.
Right rounded exterior transition from the ring head into the handle rail.

features.name: circular through-hole in the ring head

feature_functions.name: fastener_engagement
feature_functions.function: Receives and encloses a fastener or cylindrical interface through the full 15 mm part thickness.

feature_functions.name: coaxial_relationship
feature_functions.function: The cylindrical bore is approximately concentric with the outer ring profile and has its axis parallel to the part thickness direction.

feature_functions.name: physical_behavior
feature_functions.function: Contact loads on the bore are distributed into the surrounding annular material and then transferred through the neck into the handle.

brep_faces.semantic_role: Full-depth cylindrical inner wall of the 10 mm radius ring opening.
